name: 回环长竖
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: ONE independent handwriting test sheet for ONE selected Chinese hand, landscape 3:2, 1536x1024 or higher, pure white background and black ink only.
Input image 1 is the original user-authorized handwriting sample: PRIMARY reference for glyph skeleton, terminals, pressure rhythm, narrow/broad proportions, and human imperfections. Input image 2 is the approved calibration lettering of this same style: supporting reference for the pen weight and the grouping of characters. Both reference handwriting only; ignore old wording, photos, scenery, pens, paper texture, color, angle of photographed paper, and layout. Do not copy the old words.
Write EXACTLY TWO separate text groups, each horizontal on its own baseline:
Upper short group (3 characters): 「雨停了」. Character order: 雨 / 停 / 了.
Lower long group (8 characters): 「把日子写成一封信」. Character order: 把 / 日 / 子 / 写 / 成 / 一 / 封 / 信.
No other text, labels, numbers or punctuation. All simplified Chinese. Do not merge the two groups or add a third line. Place the short group centered around y=270 and the long group centered around y=740 on a 1536x1024 canvas; generous whitespace between them. The lower eight characters must remain on ONE line. Lettering fills at most 85% canvas width; preserve complete strokes with margins. This is a handwriting test, not a uniform font specimen: keep natural changes in size, width and posture characteristic of this specific hand.
Keep required character structure: 雨 has its enclosing structure and four internal drops; 停 retains 亻 and 亭 with the actual bottom 丁 stem; 把 retains 扌 and 巴; 日 retains an interior horizontal; 封 has two 土 at left and 寸 at right; 信 has 亻 and 言. Keep the two phrases readable without smoothing out the personal quirks.
The selected hand rules below determine pen weight and whether there is a long stroke. Any extended stroke starts in the actual glyph, never a disconnected flourish. Do not force long tails on short-tail styles. Do not thicken the handwriting just to fill the frame.
No scene, paper, shadows, doodles, icons, border, English, watermark, drop shadow or decorative underline. Preserve genuine individual pen turns; do not substitute an off-the-shelf font with distortion.

本款：F41 回环长竖。
必须保留：
- 普通笔画细而柔韧，局部转弯回成小圈；字身松散，内部留白大。
- 只挑一根适合的自然竖画明显向下拉长，偏直，末端轻收；其余字有宽有窄、有高有低。
- 短片名可放大一个字，长句则保留一个长竖和少量回环，其余字收紧，仍逐字认得出来。
避免：整组字连成难辨的一根乱线；把长直竖改成每个字都有的大弯钩；写成整齐的瘦金体或标准行书。
这一款在上组拉长「停」中实际的丁竖，下组只挑「封」的寸竖略拉长，偏直，末端小收；不要整组串成乱线。

name: 收紧连笔
prompt:
生成一张白底黑字的个人手写字稿，横向3:2，1536×1024。图1是原始手写字，为主参考；图2是同一写法的校准图。请像原稿作者换句话写，沿用原稿字身的松紧、用笔和小毛病。两张图片只参考字形，不带入旧文字、背景与图案。画面只有两组文字，上组「雨停了」，下组「把日子写成一封信」，下组八字完整单行，四周与上下之间留白，不加标签、数字或其他文字。各字偏旁能认出：雨里四个点，停的亻与亭，把的扌与巴，日内横，封的两个土与寸，信的亻与言均保留。
重点仿图1「一切刚刚好」里面细笔紧凑快写的手。字身略窄，部件收在一起，字内有自然小回绕：像原稿里切的回环和刚的小折返，有几处不断笔，但字间不强行串联。上组雨略扁，停窄而微倾，了较小；下组日和信收窄，写的上盖收紧，成略歪，封的部件互相靠近但留细缝。小回环长在实际笔画里，不是加在字旁的小圈。每个字要有自然不齐的宽窄和高低，像一口气快速记下，收笔短。保住原稿的细线与压笔，不做圆头记号笔，不画任何撑场的长竖或长钩，不规整成端正练字，不加装饰。
